name: The Starlit Crystal
source:
The young witch is sent on a quest to help a fairy village.

Game is based on characters from the webcomic Pepper & Carrot by David Revoy.

[from [url=https://miniputs.itch.io/the-starlit-crystal]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
年轻女巫受命出发，帮助一座仙灵村庄。

游戏以大卫·勒沃伊的网络漫画《小辣椒与萝卜头》中的角色为基础。

[摘自[url=https://miniputs.itch.io/the-starlit-crystal]itch.io[/url]]
